summary: Self-paced 300 hour online yoga teacher training with more than 150 hours of pre-recorded sessions plus live Zoom classes on Fridays and Saturdays.
intro: Join Bali Yoga School with our self-paced online yoga teacher training and become a RYT300 with Yoga Alliance. You can complete this course between 3 months and 6 months according to your comfort and schedule. This 300 hour self-paced online yoga teacher training course offers more than 150 hours of pre-recorded yoga session videos with yoga teachers in Rishikesh. You will have live zoom classes on Fridays and Saturdays, and you will be eligible to take those sessions for one year even after the completion of this 300 YTT. You also will have access to all the pre-recorded sessions for one year.

This 300 hour online yoga teacher training course is for you if you have completed a 200 YTT either online or offline and are ready to dive deeper in the world of traditional yoga teachings and practices.
You can join the course at any time, all you need is to write us an email, we will guide you to book the course.
